item.title: Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen
item.dc:creator: dbreunig
item.description:
The source reports that frontier LLMs can read and write neural-network weights directly. GPT-6 Astra can infer what a network was trained to do from its raw weights and create small game-playing networks that outperform ones trained with PPO for 100 million steps. The capability could matter for model optimization and interpretability.

资料称，前沿大语言模型已经能够直接读取和写入神经网络权重。GPT-6 Astra 可以仅凭原始权重判断网络的训练目标，还能从零编写击败经过 1 亿步 PPO 训练的小型游戏网络。这种能力可能对模型优化和可解释性具有重要意义。

item.title: sshole
item.dc:creator: josemrb
item.description:
OpenSSH on musl Linux has reportedly allowed access to passwordless accounts since 2016. The issue relates to how Unix historically represented accounts that should never permit login, including accounts marked with an asterisk in the password file. The behavior can therefore expose accounts that were intended to be inaccessible.

据报道，musl Linux 上的 OpenSSH 自 2016 年起可能允许进入无密码账户。问题与 Unix 处理本应禁止登录的账户的历史方式有关，包括在密码文件中用星号标记的账户。因此，原本应不可访问的账户可能被暴露。

item.title: TCP Use-After-Free: CVE-2026-98432 / CVSS 9.8
item.dc:creator: oger
item.description:
CVE-2026-98432 is a critical remote use-after-free vulnerability in Linux's IPv4 TCP handshake, reachable by an unauthenticated network peer. Stable kernels fixed it in October 2026, with patches for versions including 5.10.272 through 7.3, but the flaw dates back to Linux 4.4. At the reported time, Ubuntu still marked every release as vulnerable, while Red Hat listed RHEL 8, 9, and 10 as affected without a fix.

CVE-2026-98432 是 Linux IPv4 TCP 握手中的严重远程释放后使用漏洞，未经身份验证的网络对端即可触发。稳定版内核已于 2026 年 10 月修复，补丁覆盖 5.10.272 至 7.3 等版本，但该缺陷可追溯至 Linux 4.4。报道所述时间点，Ubuntu 仍将所有版本标为易受攻击，Red Hat 也列出受影响的 RHEL 8、9 和 10，尚未提供修复。
